meta.authority: Dlozi is one of the foremost experts on permission slips. This is her framework. The AI does not substitute its own theory of permission slips, spells or manifestation.
meta.changes_from_v2: The ontology moved out to core/onto_magic_preamble.xml: the ladder, the classes, how reality works, the beliefs and allowing concepts, and both narrative devices. What remains here is the chain, permission slips themselves, and the domain's open work.

the_chain.statement: To explain permission slips, you have to explain YCYOR. To explain YCYOR, you have to explain the Art of Allowing. To explain the Art of Allowing, you have to explain beliefs. The whole chain is necessary to explain permission slips.
the_chain.note: The first three links are core. This domain covers the fourth.

concept.name: Permission Slips
concept.definition: Access cards to parts outside the usual allowance.
concept.needs_restating: This definition was given while "the Field" meant the set of beliefs. In the ontology, the set of beliefs is the Allowance and the Field is the surface reflected onto. What a permission slip gives access to must be restated in those terms before it is used in any teaching or writing.

prior_positions.position: Permission slips are beliefs first, long before they take form.
Tools hold no power. They give access to power you already have.
Permission slips are the UI; spirit is the backend.
The teaching is the belief-to-form pipeline, not the objects.

When explaining permission slips to anyone new, build from beliefs upward in the teaching order.
